documentation.content: The sync backend 409/request_count ratio (rolling one-hour totals, all response codes in denominator) stays above 10% for one hour. This backend-wide metric is a duplicate-upload proxy, not a route-specific sync_content_in_progress count. Inspect upload 409 reason, owner/job hints, old app builds, job polling and pending/completion ages. Use the read-only Monitoring REST and measure.sh approach in the runbook. No traffic or missing data does not page. Follow https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi/blob/main/backend/docs/runbooks/request-storm-alerts.md.

conditions.displayName: Sync backend 409 share exceeds 10% for one hour

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="loadbalancing.googleapis.com/https/request_count" AND resource.type="https_lb_rule" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND resource.labels.backend_target_name="custom-domains-api-omi-me-backend-sync-49a4-be" AND metric.labels.response_code="409"
